title: Algebraic strict henselization presentation of a divisor quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f\in R$, and $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $H$ be its geometric strict henselization ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let $b:R\to H$ have spectrum equal to the structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. If $b(f)$ is not a unit, there exist a prime $p\subset R/(f)$ and a separable closure $K$ of the residue field of $A=(R/(f))_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], together with compatible residue-field and $A$-algebra structures on $K$ and an $A$-algebra structure on $H/(b(f))$, such that $H/(b(f))$ is an algebraic strict henselization of $A$ relative to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. No regularity or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Tags 04HX (Stalks of the structure sheaf) and 05WS (strict henselization of a quotient)

proof.text: Obtain the algebraic strict-henselization presentation of the geometric ring over R_q with its structural R-map equal to b.
If f were outside q, f/1 would be a unit in R_q. Its image under the local-base algebra map would be b(f), contradicting hg. Therefore f belongs to q.

Set J=(f) and p=q/J; f in q proves p prime and its contraction equals q. Choose the canonical separable closure L of the residue field of B=(R/J)_p, with its B-action through the residue map. Descend b followed by the quotient map to R/J using Ideal.Quotient.lift. Every element outside p lifts to an element outside q, which maps to a unit in R_q, hence to a unit in the quotient of the strict henselization. IsLocalization.lift gives the B-action, and lift_eq gives its compatibility with b on R. Apply the adopted upstream localized-divisor quotient theorem with these structures and package the existential witnesses.

theorem strictHenselizationRing_divisor_quotient_presentation
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : R)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY)
    (hg : ¬ IsUnit (b.hom f)) :
    ∃ (p : Ideal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (_ : p.IsPrime)
      (K : Type u) (_ : Field K)
      (_ : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) K)
      (_ : IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) K)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) K)
      (_ : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) K)
      (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (strictHenselizationRing barY ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})),
      Algebra.IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) K
        (strictHenselizationRing barY ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})
